name: Jitters
shortDescription: Duskwood witness identified through a separate quest branch; his partial book recounts a scythe found at Roland’s Doom, an ensuing attack and his escape.
body: Interpretive human portrait based on the separate Duskwood quest and item testimony. No formal faction membership is asserted. See docs/research/scythe-of-elune-original-mystery-research.md and docs/research/scythe-of-elune-visual-assets.json.
